description: Juba Traffic Data is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors William Lyons. Traffic Data, including traffic volumes and crashes, from Juba, South Sudan, relating to the Gudele Road and several major intersections in the city. Coverage: national (SS); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
